description: AI models you can use with Sorzio, featured models first, then by provider and price, with price per 1,000 rows and whether they support web search or reasoning. Default to openai/gpt-4o-mini for bulk runs; never choose a reasoning or high-cost model unless the user explicitly asks for that model by name. Use the id with estimate_cost and other AI tools. Free.

search.description: Filter by text in the id or name.

supports_web_search.description: When true, only return models that support live web search (such as perplexity/sonar, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and xAI Grok).
